title: Fixed-degree coproduct comparison for derived direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $(E_i)_{i\in I}$ be any set-indexed family in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $S\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ with coprojections $\iota_i:E_i\to S$ satisfying the ambient coproduct universal property. For each fixed integer $q$, the morphism of module sheaves $\bigoplus_i H^q(Rf_*E_i)\to H^q(Rf_*S)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] induced by the $H^q(Rf_*\iota_i)$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08DZ, proof: cohomology comparison, with Tag 08D5(2)

proof.text: For each affine open U of Y choose a common lower-truncation index a for the family and S, with invertible evaluated vertical maps, using the affine uniform truncation theorem. The lower-truncated coproduct comparison is invertible by the truncated comparison theorem. Naturality of the truncation projection proves c composed with r equals l composed with d: check each coprojection and use functoriality. Evaluation at U preserves this square and the isomorphism d. Hence c composed with r is invertible, and cancelling the invertible r proves c invertible on U. The underlying additive sheaf map is therefore invertible on the affine basis by TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_iff_isIso_basis. The forgetful functor from module sheaves to additive sheaves reflects isomorphisms, giving the asserted original comparison.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08DZ: combine local common truncation and bounded-below spectral sequence by the naturality square; affine-basis gluing is Lean proof by B3.
